core_struggle: Her three-year relationship ended with a single text, and now she cannot stop watching his story and wondering if she is going mad.
mirror: Three years, one text, and now the story you cannot look away from.

queries.hook: The ache of a love that was real and has now ended, and the mind that will not stop replaying the moment it left.
queries.diagnose: Grief is love with nowhere to go; everything that comes together must part, and the heart aches because the bond was real.
queries.steady: What is real in you cannot be taken; the love was real, the ending was real, and both can be true at once.
queries.act: Let the heart feel what it feels, and let the mind rest; do not watch the story again today, and write down what the bond gave you.
queries.story: A woman who loved deeply and was left by a single text, who learned that grief is love with nowhere to go, and found her footing again.

weeks: Grief is love with nowhere to go
emotion: heartbroken and unable to let go
bridge: What you are living with is what the texts call not feeling good enough, and that is where this week begins.

week_beats.hook: You recognise the ache and the replaying, named without blame.
week_beats.diagnose: You see that grief is love with nowhere to go, and that is why the heart aches.
week_beats.steady: You hold that what is real in you cannot be taken, and both the love and the ending can be true.
week_beats.act: You try one act of letting the heart feel, and one act of turning away from the story.
week_beats.story: A woman who loved and was left shows you that grief is love with nowhere to go, and that you can survive it.

insight: You are not going mad. You are grieving a real bond that ended by a text, and the mind will not let it rest until it is named.
